rules.upgrade: First native playerKillCount credit, including a recent knockoff death
rules.activity: Actual damage_taken or damage_dealt custom statistic at least 1 (0.1 health)
rules.death: Feet block lava force-kill; ordinary native lethal damage; one random pending respawn per tick
rules.rawScore: All start at initial player count; third death sets elimination order; last survivor retains initial count

adaptations: The shared vote/introduction replaces global ready-up items, scheduled dialogue, music and advancement popups.
Intercepted deaths reuse the player entity; next-tick random respawn restores native health/hurt state and 60-tick join protection.
Only this match's players and token-tagged dropped sticks are affected; source global gamerules, objectives and entity scans are not run.
Permanent departures do not wait for reconnect; shared five-round tournament handles forfeits and converts raw placement scores to tournament points.
Doubles is not enabled by the current free-for-all Party session.
